_comment: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE. Optional. Claims that must never be written, checked in every pack: the rendered CV, the cover letter and each form answer. banned_claims are errors: in the model's CV tagline or summary they bring back the vetted text, and a CV whose vetted text still breaks one is not built or sent. warn_claims and limits are warnings under 'Check before sending'. Patterns are JavaScript regex with flags giu (case-insensitive, Unicode). Every fact you correct is a good new rule.

banned_claims.why: Alex was not the first PM at Brightgrid or at Parcelpoint.
Alex has never held a head-of-product title.

warn_claims.why: Empty words; say what was done instead.
Alex ships AI-assisted features but is not a researcher; name what was built.
